The issuer demonstrates strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 32% (operating income of $6,598M on $20,880M in revenue) and a high gross margin of 85%. However, its balance sheet shows significant leverage with total liabilities of $274,899M against total assets of $308,894M (equity of $33,995M), and a very weak short-term liquidity profile indicated by a current ratio of 0.35 (current assets of $56,524M versus current liabilities of $159,640M). This combination of strong underlying earnings power but substantial leverage and short-term refinancing/liquidity risk aligns with a high speculative-grade rating.
